title: Theaflavine inhibits hepatic stellate cell activation by modulating the PKA/LKB1/AMPK/GSK3beta cascade and subsequently enhancing Nrf2 signaling.
authors: Shu, Guangwen; Sun, Hui; Zhang, Tiantian; Zhu, Anqi; Lei, Xiao; Wang, Chuo; Song, Anning; Deng, Xukun
one_liner_zh: 研究茶黄素通过PKA/LKB1/AMPK/GSK3beta/Nrf2通路抑制肝星状细胞活化，涉及蛋白-蛋白互作和分子对接，但核心是信号通路而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或MD方法。
abstract: Activation of hepatic stellate cells (HSCs) constitutes a crucial etiological factor leading to liver fibrosis. Theaflavine (TF) is a characteristic bioactive compound in fermented tea. Here, we found that TF attenuated the activation of LX-2 HSCs induced by transforming growth factor-beta1 (TGF-beta1). TF potentiated nuclear factor erythroid 2-related Factor 2 (Nrf2) signaling. Knockdown of Nrf2 abrogated TF-mediated resistance to TGF-beta1. Liver kinase B1 (LKB1), AMP-activated kinase (AMPK), and glycogen synthase kinase-3beta (GSK3beta) are upstream regulators of Nrf2. TF modulated the LKB1/AMPK/GSK3beta axis. Inhibition of AMPK or knockdown of LKB1 crippled TF-mediated potentiation of Nrf2. Protein kinase A (PKA) catalyzes LKB1 phosphorylation. In LX-2 cells, TF increased the LKB1/PKA interaction without affecting their contents. Inhibition of PKA abolished TF-mediated potentiation of LKB1/Nrf2 and abrogated the inhibitory effects of TF on their activation. TF also enhanced direct binding between purified catalytic subunit alpha of PKA (PKA-Calpha) and LKB1 proteins in vitro. Molecular docking indicated that TF showed binding activity with both LKB1 and PKA-Calpha proteins. In mouse primary HSCs, TF elevated LKB1/PKA-Calpha binding, boosted LKB1 phosphorylation, potentiated Nrf2 and suppressed their spontaneous activation. PKA inhibition or LKB1 knockdown eliminated TF-mediated induction of Nrf2 and suppression of HSC activation. Furthermore, TF considerably alleviated CCl(4)-induced mouse liver fibrosis. In mouse livers, TF increased the LKB1/PKA-Calpha interaction, upregulated LKB1 phosphorylation and modulated its downstream AMPK/GSK3beta/Nrf2 cascade. Our findings collectively indicated that TF suppresses HSC activation. Mechanistically, TF elevated the LKB1/PKA interaction in HSCs, which increased LKB1 phosphorylation and subsequently modulated the downstream AMPK/GSK3beta/Nrf2 axis.
abstract_zh: 肝星状细胞（HSCs）的激活是导致肝纤维化的关键病因因素。茶黄素（TF）是发酵茶中的一种特征性生物活性化合物。在此，我们发现TF减弱了由转化生长因子-β1（TGF-β1）诱导的LX-2 HSCs的激活。TF增强了核因子E2相关因子2（Nrf2）信号通路。Nrf2的敲低消除了TF介导的对TGF-β1的抵抗。肝激酶B1（LKB1）、AMP激活激酶（AMPK）和糖原合酶激酶-3β（GSK3β）是Nrf2的上游调控因子。TF调节了LKB1/AMPK/GSK3β轴。AMPK的抑制或LKB1的敲低削弱了TF介导的Nrf2增强。蛋白激酶A（PKA）催化LKB1磷酸化。在LX-2细胞中，TF增加了LKB1/PKA相互作用，而不影响其含量。PKA的抑制消除了TF介导的LKB1/Nrf2增强，并废除了TF对其激活的抑制作用。TF还增强了纯化的PKA催化亚基α（PKA-Cα）与LKB1蛋白在体外的直接结合。分子对接表明TF与LKB1和PKA-Cα蛋白均表现出结合活性。在小鼠原代HSCs中，TF提高了LKB1/PKA-Cα结合，增强了LKB1磷酸化，强化了Nrf2并抑制了其自发激活。PKA抑制或LKB1敲低消除了TF介导的Nrf2诱导和HSC激活抑制。此外，TF显著减轻了CCl(4)诱导的小鼠肝纤维化。在小鼠肝脏中，TF增加了LKB1/PKA-Cα相互作用，上调了LKB1磷酸化并调节了其下游AMPK/GSK3β/Nrf2级联。我们的研究结果共同表明TF抑制HSC激活。机制上，TF在HSCs中提高了LKB1/PKA相互作用，这增加了LKB1磷酸化，并随后调节了下游AMPK/GSK3β/Nrf2轴。
